image_camera_contract.proposed_common_base: The 937 calibrated OPF camera IDs joined by exact basename to Images.zip.

c1_source_proposal.outcome_free_basis: Numeric header-bbox screening in the two declared but not yet registered UTM32 frames supports nadir as the provisional candidate and avoids an unvalidated overlapping merge. Exact AOI coverage and source freeze remain blocked until EPSG:32632-to-EPSG:25832 transform/residual and per-building coverage are verified.
required_recipe_steps: Bind the source EPSG:32632 axis/unit and the still-unknown vertical datum.
Freeze the EPSG:32632-to-EPSG:25832 horizontal and vertical transformation with residual evidence.
Crop only to the outcome-free AOI and apply a frozen low-Z/outlier rule.
Run a provenance-bound non-GT ground/building classifier and emit ground=2, building=6 into a new immutable derivative.
Record class inventory, per-building coverage, density, input/output hashes and registration residual.
